readerCopy.body: Something new can become possible once an old structure is no longer being preserved simply because it used to hold power. When Pluto trines the North Node, leverage and forward movement reinforce each other, supporting major changes in money, access, authority, responsibility, or control when the old arrangement has become the thing blocking the next one. The future does not need every piece of the old power structure to survive. Change becomes easier when control is transferred to the place that can actually support what comes next.
